shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਹੋਏ ਬਿਨ ਲੋਹ ਜੋ ਫਿਰੈ
verses.translit_en: sikh hoe bin loh jo firai

en.bdb: Being a Sikh if one goes around without a sword,

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲ ਅਤਿਥਿ ਕਾ ਬਲ ਕਰੇ ਛਲੈ
verses.translit_en: maal atith kaa bal kare chhalai

en.bdb: If he swindles the effects of the guest,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਸਭ ਨਿਹਫਲੈ। (੨੨)
verses.translit_en: jap tap taa(n) ko sabh nihafalai| (22)

en.bdb: All his prayer and worship bear no fruit.(22)
